One continuous muted-gold band runs flat along the front edge of the lower row of niches. A classical white-marble column stands to the right as the family signature, clearly separated from the wall.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, the wall of niches filling the left two thirds, generous empty ivory space at the right, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble render, monumental carving with real weight, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming. Gold glows softly FROM WITHIN, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
